entities.summary: Horace Augustus Hildreth was an American diplomat, businessman and Republican politician. He served as the Governor of Maine for two two-year terms, and served as United States Ambassador to Pakistan under president Dwight D. Eisenhower. He also founded the company that became Diversified Communications.
